name: lysozyme activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of the beta-(1->4) linkages between N-acetylmuramic acid and N-acetyl-D-glucosamine residues in a peptidoglycan.

name: acid phosphatase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: an orthophosphoric monoester + H2O = an alcohol + phosphate, with an acid pH optimum.

name: adenylate cyclase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: ATP = 3',5'-cyclic AMP + diphosphate.

name: alcohol dehydrogenase (NAD+) activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: an alcohol + NAD+ = an aldehyde or ketone + NADH + H+.

name: alkaline phosphatase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: a phosphate monoester + H2O = an alcohol + phosphate, with an alkaline pH optimum.

name: arylsulfatase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: a phenol sulfate + H2O = a phenol + sulfate.

name: cytochrome-c oxidase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: 4 Fe(II)-[cytochrome c] + O2 + 8 H+(in) = 4 Fe(III)-[cytochrome c] + 2 H2O + 4 H+(out).

name: endopeptidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain.

name: aminopeptidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a single N-terminal amino acid residue from a polypeptide chain.

name: serine-type endopeptidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of internal, alpha-peptide bonds in a polypeptide chain by a catalytic mechanism that involves a catalytic triad consisting of a serine nucleophile that is activated by a proton relay involving an acidic residue (e.g. aspartate or glutamate) and a basic residue (usually histidine).

name: exo-alpha-sialidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of alpha-(2->3)-, alpha-(2->6)-, alpha-(2->8)-glycosidic linkages of terminal sialic residues in oligosaccharides, glycoproteins, glycolipids, colominic acid and synthetic substrates.

name: glutamate decarboxylase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate = 4-aminobutanoate + CO2.

name: L-glutamate dehydrogenase (NADP+) activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: L-glutamate + NADP+ + H2O = 2-oxoglutarate + NH4+ + NADPH + H+.

name: DNA nuclease activity
description: Catalysis of the cleavage of ester linkages within deoxyribonucleic acid.

name: alpha-amylase activity
description: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->4)-alpha-D-glucosidic linkages in polysaccharides containing three or more alpha-(1->4)-linked D-glucose units.

name: alpha-galactosidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-D-galactose residues in alpha-D-galactosides, including galactose oligosaccharides, galactomannans and galactolipids.

name: alpha-1,4-glucosidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-(1->4)-linked alpha-D-glucose residues with release of alpha-D-glucose.

name: alpha-mannosidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-D-mannose residues in alpha-D-mannosides.

name: alpha-L-fucosidase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: an alpha-L-fucoside + H2O = an alcohol + L-fucose.

name: beta-N-acetylhexosaminidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing N-acetyl-D-hexosamine residues in N-acetyl-beta-D-hexosaminides.

name: beta-galactosidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing beta-D-galactose residues in beta-D-galactosides.

name: beta-glucuronidase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: a beta-D-glucuronoside + H2O = an alcohol + D-glucuronate.

name: beta-mannosidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing beta-D-mannose residues in beta-D-mannosides.

name: ornithine decarboxylase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: L-ornithine + H+ = CO2 + putrescine.

name: peptidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a peptide bond. A peptide bond is a covalent bond formed when the carbon atom from the carboxyl group of one amino acid shares electrons with the nitrogen atom from the amino group of a second amino acid.

name: beta-glucosidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing beta-D-glucose residues with release of beta-D-glucose.

name: 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate deaminase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: 1-aminocyclopropane-1-carboxylate + H2O = 2-oxobutanate + NH4.

name: arginine decarboxylase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + H+ = agmatine + CO2.

name: beta-lactamase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: a beta-lactam + H2O = a substituted beta-amino acid.

name: cellulase activity
description: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-glucosidic linkages in cellulose, lichenin and cereal beta-D-glucans.

name: endochitinase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of nonterminal (1->4)-beta linkages of N-acetyl-D-glucosamine (GlcNAc) polymers of chitin and chitodextrins. Typically, endochitinases cleave randomly within the chitin chain.

name: lysine decarboxylase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: L-lysine + H+ = cadaverine + CO2.

name: nicotinamidase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: nicotinamide + H2O = nicotinate + NH4+.

name: tryptophanase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: L-tryptophan + H2O = indole + NH4 + pyruvate.

name: xylan 1,4-beta-xylosidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-xylans so as to remove successive D-xylose residues from the non-reducing termini.

name: amylase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of amylose or an amylose derivative.

name: nitrogenase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: 16 ATP + 16 H2O + N2 + 8 reduced [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] = 16 ADP + 6 H+ + H2 + 2 NH4+ + 8 oxidized [2Fe-2S]-[ferredoxin] + 16 phosphate.

name: alanyl aminopeptidase activity
description: Catalysis of the release of an N-terminal amino acid, preferentially alanine, from a wide range of peptides, amides and arylamides.

name: lipase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a lipid.

name: hydrolase activity, acting on ester bonds
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of any ester bond.

name: phosphatase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a phosphoric monoester, releasing a phosphate.

name: ligase activity
description: Catalysis of the joining of two molecules, or two groups within a single molecule, using the energy from the hydrolysis of ATP, a similar triphosphate, or a pH gradient.

name: pyroglutamyl-peptidase activity
description: Catalysis of the release of the N-terminal pyroglutamyl group from a peptide or protein.

name: ribulose-bisphosphate carboxylase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: 2 (2R)-3-phosphoglycerate + 2 H+ = CO2 + D-ribulose 1,5-bisphosphate + H2O.

name: arginine deiminase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: L-arginine + H2O = L-citrulline + NH4+.

name: deaminase activity
description: Catalysis of the removal of an amino group from a substrate, producing a substituted or nonsubstituted ammonia (NH4+/NH2R).

name: alpha-L-rhamnosidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing alpha-L-rhamnose residues in alpha-L-rhamnosides.

name: endo-1,4-beta-xylanase activity
description: Catalysis of the endohydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-xylosidic linkages in xylans.

name: hydrogenase (acceptor) activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: H2 + A = AH2.

name: beta-D-fucosidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing beta-D-fucose residues in beta-D-fucosides.

name: beta-agarase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of (1->4)-beta-D-galactosidic linkages in agarose, giving the tetramer as the predominant product.

name: 6-phospho-beta-galactosidase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: a 6-phospho-beta-D-galactoside + H2O = 6-phospho-D-galactose + an alcohol.

name: tripeptide aminopeptidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of a single N-terminal amino acid residue from a tripeptide.

name: phenylalanine ammonia-lyase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: L-phenylalanine = NH4 + trans-cinnamate.

name: alpha-L-arabinofuranosidase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal non-reducing alpha-L-arabinofuranoside residues in alpha-L-arabinosides.

name: alpha-glucuronidase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: an alpha-D-glucuronoside + H2O = an alcohol + D-glucuronate.

name: D-benzoylarginine-4-nitroanilide amidase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: N(2)-benzoyl-D-arginine-4-nitroanilide + H2O = 4-nitroaniline + N(2)-benzoyl-D-arginine + H+.

name: fructose-6-phosphate phosphoketolase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: D-fructose 6-phosphate + phosphate = acetyl phosphate + D-erythrose 4-phosphate + H2O.

name: hippurate hydrolase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: N-benzoylglycine + H2O = benzoate + glycine.

name: 4-hydroxyphenylacetate 3-monooxygenase activity
description: Catalysis of the reaction: (4-hydroxyphenyl)acetate + FADH(2) + O2 = 3,4-dihydroxyphenylacetate + FAD + H+ + H2O.

name: alpha-D-xyloside xylohydrolase activity
description: Catalysis of the hydrolysis of terminal, non-reducing alpha-D-xylose residues with release of alpha-D-xylose.
